input: Enroll in a community urban planning public meeting

gold.taskTitle: Enroll in a Community Urban Planning Meeting
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and register for a public community meeting focused on urban planning in their area.

questions.title: Which city or neighborhood is this meeting for?
questions.description: Identify the specific geographic area or municipality the urban planning meeting is associated with.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific meeting in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has already identified a particular meeting or needs help finding one.

questions.title: What urban planning topic does the meeting cover?
questions.description: Clarify the subject matter, such as zoning changes, transportation, housing development, or green spaces.

questions.title: Is there a target date or deadline to enroll by?
questions.description: Understand any time constraints around when registration must be completed or when the meeting takes place.

questions.title: Will you attend in person, online, or either?
questions.description: Establish the preferred or available format for attending the public meeting.

questions.title: Why do you want to attend this particular meeting?
questions.description: Understand the user's motivation, such as voicing concerns, staying informed, or participating in a vote.

questions.title: Have you attended a public planning meeting before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's familiarity with the enrollment and participation process to tailor the plan accordingly.
